title: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones - Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1 - Repair Tools & Equipment
exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Which of the following describes the two variations of a multi-meter explicitly mentioned for use in GSM repairs?
questions.explain: Multi-meters come in two main variations: digital, which provides precise numerical readouts, and analog, which uses a moving mechanical needle to display measurements.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: A hot air rework station is commonly referred to by which alternative name in the repair guidelines?
questions.explain: A hot air rework station is commonly referred to as a heat gun. It is used to blow precisely temperature-controlled hot air to melt solder for surface-mount components.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Which of the following is listed as a primary screwdriving tool shape used in mobile phone dismantling?
questions.explain: Torx is a very common type of screw used in mobile phones. Technicians rely heavily on Torx screwdrivers to safely dismantle device housings without stripping the star-shaped screw heads.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: A technician needs to recreate the grid of solder connections underneath a detached motherboard chip. Which specialized item from the equipment list should be used?
questions.explain: BGA (Ball Grid Array) chips connect to the motherboard via a grid of tiny solder balls. A re-balling kit contains the metal stencils and solder paste needed to recreate these connections when a chip is removed.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Which tool is explicitly recommended to provide external voltage and current testing when diagnosing mobile phone power faults?
questions.explain: A DC power supply allows a technician to inject a specific, controlled voltage and current into a logic board, making it an essential tool for identifying short circuits, dead components, and power faults.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: To manipulate tiny surface mount components safely without burning one's fingers during heat gun operations, which standard hand tool is utilized?
questions.explain: Tweezers are a precision hand tool indispensable for safely gripping, placing, and removing tiny, hot surface-mount components during soldering or rework processes.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Which visual aid tool is included in the basic GSM repair tool list?
questions.explain: Because mobile phone components are extremely small, a magnifying glass or microscope is a basic visual aid required to inspect motherboard traces, solder joints, and microchips effectively.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: If a mobile phone is bricked due to a corrupt operating system and requires a firmware rewrite, which listed equipment is appropriate for this software-level repair?
questions.explain: Flash boxes and dongles are specialized hardware interfaces that allow technicians to bypass standard software locks, repair bootloaders, and write fresh firmware directly to a device's memory.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Phillips is a type of what commonly used mobile repair tool?
questions.explain: Phillips is a standard type of screwdriver with a cross-shaped tip, frequently used to remove internal screws and securing brackets within mobile phones.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Which tool would a technician require primarily for melting metallic filler to join electrical components on a printed circuit board?
questions.explain: A soldering iron heats up a metallic alloy (solder) until it melts, allowing technicians to create secure electrical and physical bonds between components and the printed circuit board.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: A GSM repair technician uses a hot air rework station to reflow a faulty power IC, but realizes the new component must be extracted and accurately placed while the solder is liquid. Which secondary hand tool from the syllabus is mandatory to grip the IC safely?
questions.explain: Since a hot air rework station blasts high heat to melt solder, tweezers are required to carefully and precisely grip or place tiny integrated circuits without burning the technician's fingers.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Which tool type, mentioned in the guidelines, helps verify continuity and voltage drops across a logic board?
questions.explain: A multi-meter is the standard diagnostic tool for checking continuity (unbroken electrical paths) and measuring voltage, current, and resistance across a phone's logic board.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: A logic board demonstrates a continuous short-to-ground which drops the voltage drastically. What equipment listed in the GSM repair tools is actively used to safely inject a specific voltage to find the localized heating of the shorted component?
questions.explain: By using a DC power supply to inject a specific, controlled voltage into a shorted line, the compromised component will draw excess current and heat up, allowing the technician to physically locate the fault.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: A mobile device keeps entering 'bootloop' status, suggesting a corrupted bootloader. A technician connects the logic board to a computer interface tool to push raw software files into the phone's memory. Which item from the syllabus is utilized?
questions.explain: Flash boxes and dongles are proprietary hardware tools that connect a phone to a PC, enabling a technician to force-write lower-level software, flash firmware, or repair a corrupted bootloader.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Which of the following describes the shape of the Torx screwdriver tip?
questions.explain: The Torx screw head features a distinct 6-point star-shaped pattern. It provides excellent grip and reduces the risk of cam-out (stripping the screw) during delicate phone assembly.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: When assessing a diagnostic tool for varying electrical levels in older phone systems, why might a technician choose the 'analog' version of a multi-meter over the 'digital' version?
options: It is easier to observe rapid fluctuations via needle sweeps
It can re-ball BGA chips automatically
questions.explain: While digital multi-meters show precise numbers, analog meters feature a sweeping mechanical needle. This makes it easier to visually detect rapid, pulsating voltage drops or shorts that might just look like jumping numbers on a digital screen.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: If a BGA chip is structurally sound but the micro-connections underneath are fractured due to drop damage, what is the most appropriate action utilizing the prescribed tools?
options: Use a BGA re-balling kit to restore the solder connections
Use a flash dongle to reconfigure the system hardware flags
Wash the board with a magnifying glass
questions.explain: When a chip's underlying solder joints break, the chip itself often still works. A BGA re-balling kit uses a metal stencil and solder paste to perfectly reform those microscopic solder balls so the chip can be safely reattached.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Which combination of parameters MUST be correctly regulated on a Hot Air Rework Station (heat gun) to successfully detach a delicate Surface Mount Device (SMD) without blowing away neighboring components?
options: Software firmware version and Flash protocol
questions.explain: A hot air rework station has two critical settings: temperature (to safely melt the specific solder alloy) and airflow velocity (which must be kept low enough to prevent blowing microscopic, neighboring components off the board).
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: When a technician uses a DC power supply to 'wake up' a deeply discharged battery that refuses to accept charge via normal methods, what technical requirement of the tool is being leveraged?
options: Its ability to read data paths via analog needles
Its ability to output direct, adjustable voltage and current
questions.explain: A DC power supply provides a heavily regulated output of direct voltage and current. This allows technicians to manually force a charge into a battery whose voltage has dropped too low for the phone's native charging circuit to recognize.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Which tool would be essentially useless for a repair requiring board-level physical modification, but critical for a device locked by a network carrier?
questions.explain: Flash boxes and USB dongles are dedicated entirely to software repairs, such as flashing firmware, unlocking network carrier restrictions, and rewriting baseband data, offering no utility for physical board-level fixes.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: What type of screwdriver is identified by a cross-shaped head and is commonly paired with Torx in the mobile repair toolset?
questions.explain: The Phillips screwdriver is an industry standard characterized by its cross-shaped tip, which centers itself in the screw head to provide even torque when removing internal components.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: While checking the continuous connection between two traces on a motherboard (continuity testing), the digital multi-meter will typically emit what kind of indicator if the connection is good?
options: A high-pitched beep or buzzer tone
It will flash the smartphone firmware
questions.explain: When set to continuity mode, a digital multi-meter will emit a continuous, high-pitched beep if an unbroken electrical path exists between the two test probes, confirming the trace is intact.
questions.exam: WASSCE Maintenance and Repair of Mobile Phones
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1
